responsibility: Declares the command-line options for the MN10300 target and the generated variables that store their settings. It introduces CPU-selection and tuning switches, masks for hardware-multiply workaround, pointer return convention, LIW generation, and SETLB support, as well as linker-facing options such as mrelax/no-crt0, and ties the generated option state to mn10300-opts.h via HeaderInclude and processor variables used by the backend.
same_name_distinction: The target option-definition file for MN10300: unlike mn10300.cc it contains no backend algorithm implementations, unlike mn10300.h it is not the architectural macro/register configuration header, and unlike mn10300.md it does not define RTL instruction patterns or scheduler attributes. In this same-name group it is the declarative source of the backend's -m switches and generated option variables, including processor selection, LIW, SETLB, and linker-facing flags.
